prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a locked character master sprite for Riley Wheel Brawl 2.0.
Reference images: trolloc-master.png is ONLY the locked rendering style reference; riley-master.png is the locked style AND human pixel-scale reference. New character is an ordinary human, NEVER a monster. Match their confident dark-brown/near-black ink contours, thick outer silhouette and fine interior lines, clean 2-3 step cel shading with subtle painterly gradients, rich grounded colors and Streets of Rage 4 hand-drawn HD fighting-game finish EXACTLY.
Output: portrait 1024x1536 PNG with genuine transparent alpha background. One single full-body figure, head to boots and all equipment fully inside frame with margin. No floor, ground shadow, background glow, text, labels, borders or additional figures.
Subject: WHITECLOAK ARCHER, Children of the Light soldier, lean grown human man about 25, same height and pixel scale as Riley but distinctly slimmer. Narrow alert face, short brown beard. WHITE hooded cloak with hood UP, face clearly fully visible under hood, hem splashed brown mud. Golden SUNBURST emblem on LEFT breast of cloak. Brown leather jerkin over grey mail, leather bracers, back quiver with white-fletched arrows, brown trousers, brown boots, short sheathed knife at belt.
Pose and anatomy: side/profile with slight 3/4 view, facing LEFT, looking left toward enemy. Alert ready stance with feet apart and knees gently bent. His LEFT arm is the visible near arm toward enemy; LEFT hand holds a tall wooden longbow LOW at about hip height in front of body. Right hand lightly steadies the nocked arrow near the relaxed string. Arrow is visibly correctly nocked onto a straight relaxed bowstring, bow NOT drawn, arrow points LEFT slightly down. Two anatomically correct hands with natural fingers. Longbow is almost body-height with elegant recurved tips, clear continuous wooden limbs and string joining both tips. Arrange bow so both tips stay inside canvas and its lower tip is above the boot baseline. Preserve strong readable silhouette.
Scale: human height nearly fills portrait frame, roughly 1400-1450 pixels tall on the 1536 canvas, matching Riley's head/body/boot pixel scale as if standing beside him. Cloak conceals slim torso only partially, jerkin and mail readable.
Lighting: moderate baked soft upper LEFT key light, gentle cool rim on right edge. Not pixel art, not 3D, not photorealistic, not chibi.

Edit this archer sprite ONLY to remove the entire background and all background glow. Output 1024x1536 PNG with genuine transparent alpha: every pixel outside the figure, bow, arrow, string, quiver and equipment must be transparent, including all gaps between limbs and bow. No black fill, no grey fill, no gradient, no floor and no shadow. Preserve the exact figure, line art, colors, pose, correct hands, left-facing head, white hood and muddy cloak, sunburst, bow and relaxed nocked arrow unchanged. This is a game sprite cutout.
